name: Steakhouse Prime EURCV
oneLiner: steakEURCV is Steakhouse’s Morpho V2 EURCV lending vault; shares accrue yield, absorb strategy losses, and redeem against available liquidity.
collateral: EURCV held idle in the exact Morpho VaultV2 and supplied through its sole MorphoMarketV1 adapter; borrower collateral and market liquidity determine strategy risk.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a proportional EURCV-denominated lending position. Interest and fee-share accrual change assets per share; bad debt reduces NAV. Holder withdrawals burn shares and pay EURCV atomically when idle assets plus the selected liquidity adapter suffice.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The current holder claim is the operational ERC-4626 claim at ethereum:0xbeef0c075da5d01112ae5cf34d257074fb5ddb2f, not direct ownership of the parent’s fiat reserves. Exact verified immutable VaultV2 code pulls underlying before user mint, can mint fee shares during interest accrual, and burns receipts against available underlying on exit. Reverified at block 26107702; parent fiat-cash protections remain upstream.
